title: Delula w/ Payments
tagline: Delula – One-Click Viral Hits w/ Instant Credit Purchases & Social Logins
description:
Delula is an AI-powered platform that makes creating viral short-form video content as easy as a single click. Instead of requiring prompts, scripts, or editing, users select from pre-built “recipes” like Lava Food ASMR or Cat Olympic Diving to instantly generate meme-ready, high-quality videos designed for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

Generative AI video is expensive to run, but Delula solves the complexity gap: it abstracts away prompt engineering and GPU overhead into a credit-based system. With credits, anyone can generate and publish AI video instantly, with no friction.

By integrating Coinbase Developer Platform’s Onramp, users can seamlessly purchase platform credits using USD or USDC. Combined with Dynamic.xyz social logins, onboarding is frictionless—creators can sign in with familiar identities and start making viral content in seconds.

The vision is to democratize Generative AI for influencers, creatives, and brands: turning viral content into a repeatable, monetizable workflow. Creators can make their own recipes and receive revenue share from users they bring to Delula from their own fanbases!

http://bit.ly/4n6OWPN
how_its_made:
Delula is built with:
* Coinbase Developer Platform’s Onramp for easy purchase of credits in USD or USDC, ensuring creators can quickly fund their content generation without navigating wallets or exchanges.
Dynamic.xyz for secure, Web3-friendly social login and account creation, reducing friction and enabling cross-platform identity.
* A custom “recipe engine” that triggers video generation via AI pipelines, packaged into easy-to-use templates instead of raw prompts, optimized for order-flow to major Web2/Web3 providers of AI inference/GPUs.
* Backend orchestration designed to optimize GPU workloads for short, viral-length videos, balancing speed and cost, built on the Scrypted Network, a permissionless, confidential, x402-enabled Web3 API for Generative AI images, video, sound, music, and interactive experiences.
* Credit-based billing logic that ties Coinbase Onramp payments directly to usable generation credits: buy in fiat or USDC.
